title: Better Reasoning, Not Just Bigger Models: A Structure-Grounded Framework for Efficient and Reliable Inference
abstract: arXiv:2610.30611v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Scaling large language models has substantially improved linguistic fluency, yet reliable autonomous agents require more than fluent generation. In multi-turn inference, current agentic systems often produce semantically plausible but structurally ungrounded reasoning, especially under incomplete observations. We propose Structure-Grounded Uncertainty Reduction (SGUR), a training-free framework that complements token-level generation with active uncertainty reduction over structured hypothesis spaces. SGUR represents incomplete observations as a query graph and aligns them with candidate hypothesis graphs through a prior-weighted partial graph matching mechanism, where database-derived empirical priors assign greater importance to decision-relevant relations rather than treating all graph edges uniformly. The resulting inference state is iteratively refined by an active information-gain strategy that selects the next most informative n

translated_title: 更好的推理，而非仅仅是更大的模型：一个基于结构的高效可靠推理框架
translated_abstract: 扩展大型语言模型显著提升了语言流畅性，然而可靠的自主智能体所需要的不仅仅是流畅的文本生成。在多轮推理中，当前的智能体系统常常产生语义上合理但结构上缺乏依据的推理，尤其是在观测信息不完整的情况下。我们提出了结构化落地的 uncertainty 消减框架 SGUR（Structure-Grounded Uncertainty Reduction），这是一个无需训练的框架，通过对结构化假设空间进行主动的不确定性消减来补充词元级别的生成。SGUR 将不完整的观测表示为查询图，并通过先验加权的部分图匹配机制将其与候选假设图进行对齐，其中由数据库导出的经验先验会赋予与决策相关的关系更大的重要性，而不是对所有图的边一视同仁。由此得到的推理状态通过主动信息增益策略进行迭代优化，该策略会选择下一个信息量最大的节…
tldr: 提出了无需训练的 SGUR 框架，通过将不完整观测表示为查询图，并利用先验加权的部分图匹配和主动信息增益策略在结构化假设空间中主动消减不确定性，从而提升多轮推理的可靠性与效率。
en_tdlr: SGUR is a training-free framework that enhances reliable multi-turn inference by representing incomplete observations as query graphs and actively reducing uncertainty over structured hypothesis spaces through prior-weighted partial graph matching and an active information-gain strategy.
